tenants_timesheet_ck.name: tenants_timesheet_ck
tenants_timesheet_ck.value:
"tenants"."timesheet_day_minutes" between 15 and 1440 and "tenants"."timesheet_day_minutes" % 15 = 0
        and "tenants"."timesheet_day_start" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' and "tenants"."timesheet_day_end" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' and "tenants"."timesheet_day_end" > "tenants"."timesheet_day_start"
        and "tenants"."timesheet_working_days" <@ '{1,2,3,4,5,6,7}'::smallint[] and cardinality("tenants"."timesheet_working_days") between 1 and 7
        and "tenants"."timesheet_time_format" in ('decimal', 'clock') and "tenants"."timesheet_max_day_hours" between 1 and 24
        and "tenants"."timesheet_deadline_weekday" between 1 and 7 and "tenants"."timesheet_deadline_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' and "tenants"."timesheet_deadline_week" in ('same', 'next')

tenants_terms_ck.name: tenants_terms_ck

deals_lost_ck.name: deals_lost_ck
deals_lost_ck.value: ("deals"."lost_at" is null) = ("deals"."lost_reason" is null) and ("deals"."lost_note" is null or "deals"."lost_at" is not null)

meeting_participants_kind_ck.name: meeting_participants_kind_ck

departments_code_ck.name: departments_code_ck

employees_team_needs_department_ck.name: employees_team_needs_department_ck

projects_code_ck.name: projects_code_ck

tasks_dates_ck.name: tasks_dates_ck

tasks_estimate_ck.name: tasks_estimate_ck

time_entries_span_ck.name: time_entries_span_ck
time_entries_span_ck.value: ("time_entries"."start_time" is null) = ("time_entries"."end_time" is null) and ("time_entries"."start_time" is null or ("time_entries"."end_time" > "time_entries"."start_time" and "time_entries"."minutes" = extract(epoch from "time_entries"."end_time" - "time_entries"."start_time") / 60))
